task.title: Shut down, relieve pressure and store the pressure washer
task.shortdesc: Stop the , release trapped pressure, and drain the pump so the machine is safe to handle and ready for storage.

context.p: Follow these steps every time you finish using the machine, and before you change a nozzle, clean the inlet screen, or perform any maintenance.
context.note: If you plan to store the machine for more than 30 days, add fuel stabilizer at your last refill of the season, then run the machine for at least 5 minutes so the treated fuel reaches the carburetor.

step.cmd: Engage the trigger lock on the spray gun.
Turn the power switch to OFF and unplug the power cord.
Move the engine switch to OFF and turn the fuel valve to OFF.
Point the spray gun at the ground, release the trigger lock, and squeeze the trigger until water stops flowing.

stepresult.p: Pressure is relieved from the hose and spray gun.

step.cmd: Disconnect the garden hose, the high-pressure hose, and the spray gun.
Drain the water from the pump, hoses and spray gun.

info.p: Tip the machine so the pump outlet faces down, and hold each hose vertically until it stops dripping.

step.cmd: If you will store the machine for more than 30 days or below freezing, add pump protector.

info.p: Attach the pump protector bottle to the garden hose inlet and squeeze until foam comes out of the pump outlet.

step.cmd: Store the machine and accessories indoors in a dry place.

result.p: The machine is depressurized, drained and protected for storage.
